rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Kali Linux Tools provides AI assistants with structured access to over 40 Kali Linux security utilities through a streamable HTTP MCP server. Tools span reconnaissance (Nmap, Masscan, Subfinder), web testing (Nuclei, SQLMap, Nikto), exploitation (Metasploit, Hydra), Active Directory assessment (CrackMapExec, Impacket, Evil-WinRM), and post-exploitation (LinPEAS, WinPEAS). The server is designed for CTF challenges, authorized penetration tests with written permission, and security education.
